notes.title: Level Editor Update!
notes.notes:
The level editor for Midnight Arrow Is here! Not much to say because with the editor you can make your own level and using it you can basically do everything that is in the game (except NPC quests, but I might add that later if I get some nice feedback 💪)

There is also a new type of arrow that was never used in the game 👀

If you want to learn how to use it, I made a tutorial for it so go check it out!

https://youtu.be/Q1lfglr0fGk

notes.title: Midnight Arrow release soon
notes.notes:
🌙 Coming Soon to Steam: Midnight Arrow 🏹

I have been working hard these days to finish my game. In just one month, Midnight Arrow will be released. In case you have forgotten, these are the features that you can expect:

🔥 Features 🔥

🎮 Tight, smooth platforming
🕵️ Optional quests
🧩 Challenging puzzles
💎 Collectibles & Skins
🌟 6 unique areas with new mechanics
🎯 Test your aim, platforming, and dexterity abilities
🔦 Light your path with fire arrows
🌄 Explore distinct areas with their own mood and playstyle
🏹 Use different arrows to tackle puzzles
🗺️ Dive into an immersive platforming world

Also don't forget to stay tuned on YouTube for the last dev log of Midnight Arrow that will be posted soon. Cheers!

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChkC4u4KdnIDFh9hPqExLDg
